chapter: Clarinet fingering and the Tio family
title: Freak fingering for C sharp and B flat on the Albert system
summary: He explains the Albert-system clarinet and the unusual alternate fingerings he learned for C sharp and B flat, and a player who plugged broken keys with cork.
